keyEvents.text: Julián Palacios (Unión Santa Fe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Santiago Solari (Newell's Old Boys) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Julián Palacios (Unión Santa Fe).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Newell's Old Boys. Alan Soñora replaces Facundo Guch.
Second Half begins Newell's Old Boys 0, Unión Santa Fe 0.

Goal! Newell's Old Boys 0, Unión Santa Fe 1. Juan Pablo Ludueña (Unión Santa Fe) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Marcelo Estigarribia with a headed pass following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Cristian Tarragona (Unión Santa Fe).
Substitution, Newell's Old Boys. Ignacio Ramírez replaces Lucas Gómez.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Brahian Cuello (Unión Santa Fe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Juan Pablo Ludueña (Unión Santa Fe) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match (Newell's Old Boys).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Unión Santa Fe. Misael Aguirre replaces Julián Palacios.
Substitution, Unión Santa Fe. Bruno Pittón replaces Brahian Cuello.
Own Goal by Ignacio Isla, Unión Santa Fe. Newell's Old Boys 1, Unión Santa Fe 1.
Ignacio Ramírez (Newell's Old Boys) is shown the yellow card.
Misael Aguirre (Unión Santa Fe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Unión Santa Fe. Eric Ramírez replaces Lucas Ayala.
Jeronimo Russo (Newell's Old Boys) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Unión Santa Fe. Juan Pintado replaces Tobías Rubio.
